$comment: SM031: one concrete obligation that instantiates a base obligation. Lives nested under an extending concrete instrument's `obligations[]`, never as a standalone file and never in a base or a standalone concrete. `overrides` names the base obligation's `key` (decision 4 as amended 2026-09-30: matched by an explicit base-key reference, not by carrying the same key, because every concrete's own keys are jurisdiction-suffixed - `whs.incident_notice.au-qld` against `whs.incident_notice.au-nsw` - and one base key cannot match two states). `additionalProperties: false` is the control that refuses an override of a forbidden field: duty, consequence, protection_type, disease, severity and evidence have no place here, so a state that genuinely differs on them is a new obligation under a new key (decision 5), not an override.
title: obligation override v1

overrides.description: the `key` of the base obligation this row instantiates. Resolved against the base named by the instrument's `extends`; a key absent from that base is refused (M4: orphan override).

key.description: the flattened obligation's own stable id (SM031 decision 4: the base key is only a handle, the concrete's key is what a project reads). Required unless `removed` is true.

clause.description: the clause, section or paragraph in THIS jurisdiction's instrument

window.description: the time the duty allows in this jurisdiction, when it has one. Set it to null to clear a window the base states, where this instrument imposes the same duty with no fixed period - New South Wales' notification duty runs 'within a reasonable time', which is not a window, and inheriting the base's 24 hours would misstate the law.

window_source_field.description: the `contract_terms` field whose value overrides `window.value` when the contract states its own window (SM030 decision 5)

threshold.description: for a `threshold` base obligation only: the line this jurisdiction's instrument draws

citation.description: the primary source for this exact duty in this jurisdiction - the base's own citation is the model or representative instrument, never this state's text

caveat.description: what bounds this obligation in this jurisdiction - a local penalty, an exclusion, an amendment. Overridable (SM031 decision 4 as amended): the states' caveats genuinely differ, e.g. Queensland's 100 penalty units against New South Wales' 607 body-corporate units plus the mines exclusion.

grade.description: how close to the primary source THIS jurisdiction's row was read. `inherited` (SM031 decision 6) says the concrete was instantiated without re-reading the clause, so the register never claims it verified what it inherited.

basis.description: for a `demiton_default` grade only: the citation this default stands around

removed.description: SM031 decision 10: true when this jurisdiction's instrument genuinely does not carry the base obligation. A Tier 1 concrete that drops a base obligation without this row is refused (M4: silent drop). A `shared_shape` concrete simply does not list the duties its instrument lacks, because its base is a catalogue both states draw from.
